subject: Next steps and pilot kickoff checklist — DataCore POC
content:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@datacore.io>, Jordan Park <jordan.park@datacore.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jul 2025 15:31:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps and pilot kickoff checklist — DataCore POC

Hi Elena / Jordan — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to act from.

High-level pain & goals (from our call)
- Customer support volume is growing; existing retrieval is noisy and slow to surface relevant threads.
- Main goal: improve first-contact resolution by surfacing ranked KB answers and suggested summaries for agents.
- Constraints: PHI-like PII redaction required; low-latency for agent UI (target p95 < 500ms).

Proposed pilot scope (4 weeks)
- Ingest: 100k recent support conversations (sanitized) + KB articles (subset).
- Serve: integrate Redwood API for retrieval-augmented generation in agent UI; two routes (online low-latency + batch nightly rerank).
- Eval: prompt set of ~120 queries (we'll run automated evals + small human review). Success gates: intent extraction >85% on labeled test, p95 latency <500ms for 90% of queries, and agent acceptance score >=4/5 on blind review.

Owners & roles
- DataCore: Elena Ruiz (Product lead, prioritization), Jordan Park (Infra / network & security contact)
- Redwood: Ben Carter (Account lead), Rishi Malhotra (Solutions / SRE), Monica Patel (Customer Success - onboarding & eval coordination)

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (prep, 1 week): NDA + access, sample export, network allowlist, service account created.
- Week 1: Data ingestion and seed index; initial model routing config.
- Week 2: Prompt-eval run and iterate; integration into agent UI for internal testing.
- Week 3: Human review of evals and performance tuning.
- Week 4: Readout + mutual decision on production path (Dedicated, Private, or Hosted fallback).

Access & technical asks (minimum to start)
- Service account with read access to a sample S3 bucket (or SFTP) containing 1,000 sanitized threads + KB.
- Short-term firewall allowlist (Redwood egress IPs) or temporary VPN; Jordan to confirm preferred approach.
- Confirmation on redaction rules (PII/PHI) and a quick sample mapping to fields we should mask.
- DocuSign NDA completed (linked below).

Attachments: DataCore_POC_Charter_v1.pdf (draft charter), network-egress-instructions.docx, redwood-access-matrix.csv
Related links: HubSpot deal DC-2025-1123 (link below)

Action items (OLGA -> initials indicate owner)
- Elena: share sample export (500–1k sanitized threads) + redaction mapping by Wed 23 Jul.
- Jordan: confirm networking choice (egress allowlist vs VPN) and provide contact for network team.
- Ben: propose kickoff week windows (we suggested Aug 4) and share MLP (Ben) — DONE: attached draft charter.
- Rishi / Monica: prepare eval harness + small human review plan; plan to spin up staging endpoint once access granted.

If everyone agrees, I’ll lock Aug 4 for kickoff and send the invite + short MAF (mutual action form).

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@datacore.io>

Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps and pilot kickoff checklist — DataCore POC

Thanks Olga — this summary looks great and captures the conversation. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Data residency: for the pilot we can provide a US-only export; for production we will need to confirm if Private deployment is required (depends on customers we include).
2) Redaction: we have a small ETL that can mask emails and phone numbers but not full PHI categories — I’ll send a sample mapping. Will that be sufficient for the eval?
3) Timeline: Aug 4 works for a kickoff, but can we bump the final readout into the week of Aug 4 + 4 weeks (i.e., Aug 29) — that’s our expectation.

One ask: can Redwood share a short blurb on how you handle transient logs and retention for pilot data? Our security team will need that for the gate.

Elena Ruiz
Senior Product Manager, DataCore Analytics
elena.ruiz@datacore.io | +1 212-555-0199

Elena — great to hear Aug 4 works. I’ve attached the latest POC charter (DataCore_POC_Charter_v1.pdf) and the network doc referenced.

Quick confirmation on our side:
- Cost/variant: for pilot we’ll run a middle-ground model (quantized 16-bit variant) to balance latency and quality; we’ll include an alternative low-cost fallback route for non-critical queries.
- Retention & logs: Redwood retains pilot logs for 30 days by default and we can shorten to 7 days for this engagement. We’ll provide an SOC2 summary and our retention controls — Rishi is copied for technical details.
- Kickoff invite: proposing Tue Aug 4, 10:00–11:00 PT. If that doesn’t work, propose two alternatives.

Jordan / Elena — quick technical checklist ahead of Aug 4 kickoff. If you can confirm the items below by Fri Jul 25 we’ll be ready to spin up staging: 

1) Service account: create an IAM role with s3:GetObject for the sample bucket (provide ARN). We prefer a short-term key pair; we’ll rotate after ingestion.
2) Sample dataset: 1,000 sanitized threads + 200 KB articles in CSV/JSONL. Put in a folder named /poc-staging/ on the bucket.
3) Network: provide either (A) an allowlist of these egress IPs: 54.52.11.101, 54.52.11.102 or (B) grant a temporary VPN tunnel — your security team’s preference.
4) SSH bastion: if you prefer Private deployment testing, provide bastion host + jumpbox details; otherwise Redis/RPC endpoints should be reachable from our staging egress.
5) Redaction rules: please include mapping and examples; we’ll run a small automated check during ingestion.

We will:
- Provision a staging endpoint and upload the small eval harness to the Drive link (I’ll share shortly).
- Run an initial eval within 48 hours of successful ingestion and share a first-pass metrics dashboard.

If you want a short technical touchpoint before Aug 4, I’m free Wed Jul 23 9–11 PT. Let me know.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
